name: Nice, Winter Resort Town of the Riviera
description: Nice, on France's Mediterranean coast between the sea and the foothills of the Alps, grew from a medieval old town into a grand winter retreat. From the 18th century, British aristocrats came for the mild climate, and a modest seafront path they built in 1824 became the Promenade des Anglais. Beyond the old town, the eclectic villas and hotels of the new districts still reflect the cosmopolitan crowds who followed.
